prompt: Hi, finance here. Could you pull the checkout request counts from logs/checkout-api.log for the UTC day covered by that file? Write reports/checkout-hourly.csv with the columns hour, requests, and succeeded. Each hour value must be the ISO 8601 UTC hour start, such as 2026-03-17T14:00:00Z; sort the rows by hour and include every hour present in the log. Count only records for the /checkout path, excluding health checks and other paths. A request is succeeded when its status is below 400. Also write reports/checkout-totals.json as one line of JSON with exactly the keys requests and succeeded, containing the totals for the same checkout records. Please keep the deliverables to these counts and leave the log files unchanged.

Pass: all rules stated as applied, with the count of skipped or unparsed records. (code cannot check this because the file checks see totals, not whether the report says how they were counted)
